reviews.text: Nice staff. Good location

Pet stores are as ubiquitous as nail salons and in my opinion it’s the staff that makes all the difference. Susan (truly whenever have interacted with is wonderful) is exceptional. Helpful, knowledgeable, kind. We keep coming back even though there are at least three closer pet stores to our home.

Love coming here! We have a Saint Bernard and a German Shepherd, and they always have everything we need. The store is clean, well-stocked, and has a great selection. The staff are knowledgeable, welcoming, and always happy to help.

I especially love being able to support local owners who are such genuinely lovely people. Highly recommend shopping here! ❤️
Came in for the first time today the young man running the shop was very helpful and friendly, even provided some tips to help keep my great danes shedding under control without shaving him

Winston did an amazing job with my dog, Luna. She hasn’t been groomed professionally in a few years, so I thought she might be a little nervous. Winston took their time and make sure she was comfortable through the groom.
She looks and smells great and had a lovely time.
Amazing grooming! My dogs nails and coat look fantastic! Thank you so much Winston for creating a calm and inviting environment for Capri!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I recently brought my dog to Pet Planet Kitsilano for grooming, and I couldn't be more impressed with the experience. Having visited several grooming salons across Vancouver over the years, I can honestly say that the level of care, professionalism, and attention to detail here is exceptional.
The staff were welcoming, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about animals. My dog was treated with patience and kindness throughout the entire visit, and the grooming results exceeded my expectations. The coat was perfectly groomed, and my dog came home looking great and feeling comfortable.
What stood out most was the genuine care shown to both pets and their owners. It's rare to find a grooming team that consistently delivers such high-quality service while making the entire experience stress-free.
If you're looking for a grooming service in Vancouver that truly goes above and beyond, I highly recommend Pet Planet Kitsilano. Without a doubt, this has been the best grooming experience I've had for my dog. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Super friendly and knowledgeable staff. Food is always fresh and best quality!

My cat was having really bad skin issues for years and I went in and spoke with a really knowledgeable staff member who gave me a great suggestion for a new cat food. I tried it out and my cat’s skin is all cleared up! I’m so happy with their service.

The staff is super friendly. Always offering to help and actually know their products.

Has good freeze dried options too.
Had a lovely experience! First time creating engraved dog tag! Winston was super helpful
Favourite spot for my dog Char who loves all the staff and drags me here for treats all the time! Very friendly people and tidy store.
Thank you for always being so good to Buddy! Winston is the best! Best customer service always.

I would definitely recommend this store. It is well stocked and offers excellent variety. During my visits I have been assisted by Kris who is without a doubt the most helpful, engaging and well informed assistant I have ever come across. 5/5 for this store.
Such a lively shopping experience, for me and my dog. The staff were super helpful and chatty. My fog maki even got a treat. Great treat range! Would recommend
I shop here for kitty products. They are fantastic!
Bery friendly staff
Extremely kind and helpful. Will definitely be back and refer friends!

I had such a wonderful experience at this store! From the moment I walked in I felt genuinely welcomed. The staff is incredibly warm and helpful and they went out of their way to make sure I found exactly what I needed. Honestly it’s probably the nicest pet store I’ve ever been to! If you’re looking for a place where both you and your furry friend will be treated like family, definitely check them out.
Really friendly and helpful staff and has a lot of great choices for the dog.

We’ve now been to this store 3 times and every time are welcomed with friendly knowledgeable staff and a great selection of supplies! We just got our dog fully outfitted with functional yet stylish gear and feeling grateful to have this place in the hood!
Staff has been polite every time I've been through, they look into savings programs on food (Stella and Chewies). And have a decent selection of treats and accessories

Beyond the great location and solid product selection offered… our experience was over the top memorable because of the assistance we were offered on Canada Day 2025.  Perhaps one of the most welcoming, engaged, and well-informed workers in retail we have ever experienced.   Would recommend this to any pet owner - whether visiting town or a local

Popped into Bones Pet Store in Kitsilano hoping for a quick grab-and-go for my pup — instead, it felt like stepping into the middle of a doggy apocalypse. The store was packed, and the poor staff looked like they were barely staying afloat. It’s not their fault — they were clearly doing their best — but it was obvious they were seriously understaffed. No one could help me find what I needed, and after wandering around like a confused golden retriever for 20 minutes, I gave up and left empty-handed. Hope they get more support soon, because this was ruff. Sad to see my local pet store go down hill like this.

Great pet store. It is a bit more expensive than your regular pet store but the vast variety in products make up for it as you'll find things you wouldn't find at Tisol or Petsmart. Very friendly staff too.
Awesome staff and service. Open late!

The West Broadway location is a lovely store. Staff are friendly, helpful and the store is clean and inviting. I shopped there yesterday. A young man working there offered my dog a treat. It was quite warm in the shop (don’t know if the heat was on).  I had to complete my purchase quickly and get out of the shop as the young man had such horrible body odour. I hope the Manager addresses this.

Honestly I don’t like walking past Bones because my dog always desperately wants to go inside and get a treat. :) They have heart shaped biscuits in bulk that she loves and we also got her birthday cookies here. It’s a small shop that doesn’t normally stock the size of dog food we normally purchase but they will order if you ask and provide a deposit. We bought a new leash here and the staff member spent twenty minutes explaining all the different ways to use it. It’s been amazing and I was able to get rid of all the other leashes and halters.

Super nice staff, but to be honest, I was expecting a bigger selection of things like dog sweaters and harnesses. I also found it to be incredibly pricy. Not somewhere I would have too of my list to go to for pet products.
Great selection
Great products and convenient delivery for ordering online.

Among many things, I bought a Barbour vest for over $100 and when I tried to change the size, even with the tag, they wouldn't let me. This is the last time I'm buying from them. It's Bones on Broadway and Trafalgar Street in Kitsilano, Vancouver.
Upscale pet boutique.
Very helpful two young lads tonight, my dog even let one of them pet him!! Had assistance for the medium sized play pen carried to my car which was greatly appreciated :)

My dog has allergies to meat, gluten, and flax so it can be a real challenge to find treats for him. This branch ALWAYS has at least five options for me to choose from. They’ve also made the option to order in some other options for my dog! I find the staff so welcoming and helpful, this is my favourite place to shop for my dog.
Extremely helpful, friendly & polite Irish staff

Very friendly and helpful people work here!
They also give our doggos treats every time we drop by 🙂 …
